clos.original_description: Understand the basics of computer vision, its related fields, and its applications
clos.enriched_description: Understand the basics of computer vision, its related fields, and its applications through an overview of computer vision concepts and application areas.

clos.original_description: Understand the concepts of image formation: image representation, lighting, image acquisition through the camera, camera calibration techniques.
clos.enriched_description: Understand image formation concepts, including image representation, geometric primitives and transformations, photometric image formation, lighting, image acquisition through digital cameras, and camera calibration foundations.

clos.original_description: Basic knowledge of image processing on points, lines, image filtering techniques and corresponding algorithm implementation
clos.enriched_description: Apply basic image processing techniques and corresponding algorithms for point and line operations, image filtering, Fourier transforms, geometric transformations, and point or patch-based image processing.

clos.original_description: Understand the techniques of feature extraction and matching, implement the techniques of edges, lines extraction
clos.enriched_description: Understand feature extraction and matching techniques, including points and patches, and implement edge and line extraction techniques.

clos.original_description: Understand the basics of segmentation, techniques such as active contours, split and merge, mean shift and mode finding
clos.enriched_description: Understand the basics of image segmentation, including active contours, split and merge, mean shift, and mode finding.

clos.original_description: Discuss feature-based alignments like 2D and 3D feature-based alignment
clos.enriched_description: Discuss feature-based alignment, including 2D and 3D feature-based alignment.

clos.original_description: Discuss the principles and the implementation of Image stitching
clos.enriched_description: Discuss the principles and implementation of image stitching, including motion models and global alignment.

clos.original_description: Understand and implement the object detection techniques
clos.enriched_description: Understand and implement object detection techniques.

clos.original_description: Explain the principles of face recognition, object tracking
clos.enriched_description: Explain the principles of face recognition and object tracking techniques.
